# Bid the glass, the floor, and the roof.

> Price a residential sunroom or three-season room from the glazed-wall square feet a floor-square-foot special cannot see, the thermal floor, the insulated roof, and HVAC — plus walk-away price and proposed-price margin check.

Free and open source (MIT). Results are estimates from the numbers typed in, not legal, tax, financial or professional advice.
